description: A front-end source file for a database visualization web application, providing UI layout, styling, and client-side logic for fetching and displaying database, table, and data information.
external_files: fetch API calls to endpoints like '/api/databases', '/api/{db}/tables', '/api/{db}/tables/{table}/data'

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of database names and populates the sidebar menu.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's table list and triggers table loading.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for the selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from the selected table and renders it into an HTML table with features like horizontal scrolling and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML to display tabular data including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for each cell, handling objects, long text, and null values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects.
